## About
Welcome to Lone Star Grill & Sports Cafe, a relaxed neighborhood sports bar on N Plano Rd in Richardson. Come in with friends and family for sandwiches, fried fare, house specialties and old favorites, served in a setting that is easy to settle into.
Stay for a game. We have multiple pool tables and dart boards, and one reviewer also mentioned shuffleboard and Golden Tee. Another reviewer called us a great dive bar, and one came in for a dart tournament and stayed for the burger.
We are rated 4.3 on Google from 446 reviews, and we are open Monday thru Sunday until late.

## Services
- Sandwiches and fried fare: Sandwiches, fried fare and other grub to go with the game.
- Pool tables and dart boards: Multiple pool tables and dart boards in a spacious room.
- PBR & Coors Original all day Wednesdays: PBR and Coors Original all day on Wednesdays. ($1.75)

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open 11 AM to 2 AM, Monday through Sunday.

Q: What kind of entrees do you serve?
A: Reasonably priced entrees, including our house specialties and other customer favorites.
